assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game terrain base-color texture candidate for the omoba MOBA project, a square texture, not a scene or screenshot.
Primary request: create an original softly hand-painted meadow turf ground texture viewed straight down, with small irregular grass clusters and subtle soil visible between them, suitable for repeating across a large game ground surface. The material must be quiet enough that heroes, projectiles and selection markers read clearly above it.
Composition/framing: orthographic flat full-frame material swatch, evenly distributed small detail at consistent scale, visually seamless repeating edges, no central focal object, no horizon or perspective.
Lighting: diffuse neutral albedo only, no directional shadows, specular glare, ambient vignette, baked ambient occlusion, or scene lighting.
Palette/materials: natural muted grass greens with restrained earthy patches, moderate local contrast, stylized painted texture with readable broad shapes and fine supporting variation.
Constraints: original artwork, opaque background; no characters, buildings, flowers, paths, stones larger than small pebbles, borders, labels, text, logos, copyrighted game art or watermark. One single texture, not an atlas, mockup, grid or rendered sphere. Square 1024x1024 requested.
assets.provenance: Original artwork generated for Omoba; original candidate retained byte-identical

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game terrain base-color texture candidate for the omoba MOBA project, a square texture, not a scene or screenshot.
Primary request: an original softly hand-painted worn stone paving material viewed straight down, built from irregular medium-small flat slate flagstones with fine earth-filled joints and a few restrained moss flecks. Suitable as the repeating base-color of a readable game lane, with quiet surface detail so heroes, projectiles and selection markers read above it.
Composition/framing: orthographic flat material swatch completely filling the square, consistent detail scale and density, visually seamless repeating edges, no perspective or horizon, no central medallion or object, no outer boundary or grassy roadside.
Lighting: diffuse neutral albedo only, no directional shadows, cast shadows, bright bevel highlights, specular glare, vignette or scene illumination.
Palette/materials: restrained warm gray slate with muted taupe earth and sparse natural moss, moderate low local contrast, broad readable hand-painted shapes with subtle stone wear; original stylized fantasy material rather than photorealism.
Constraints: original opaque texture; no characters, buildings, symbols, runes, text, logos, copyrighted game art, watermarks, borders, grid, atlas, rendered sphere or mockup. One single tileable material surface. Square 1024x1024 requested.
assets.provenance: Original artwork generated for Omoba; original candidate retained byte-identical
